settings.heading: How to use
settings.content:
Take a pea-sized portion with the included spoon. Dissolve in a cup of warm water, milk or tea and drink once a day, ideally in the morning.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication.

settings.heading: Sourcing & purification
settings.content: Gathered by hand in Gilgit-Baltistan, dissolved in spring water, filtered several times and slowly sun-dried into resin. No fillers, no additives.

settings.heading: Four ways to test pure shilajit at home.

settings.title: The warm-hand test
settings.text: Real resin softens and becomes sticky in the warmth of your hand.

settings.title: The fridge test
settings.text: Chilled, it turns hard and brittle — and can shatter like glass.

settings.title: The water test
settings.text: It dissolves completely in warm water, turning it golden-brown with no grit.

settings.title: The smell test
settings.text: Smoky, earthy and mineral. Never sweet, never chemical.

settings.question: How can I tell if shilajit is pure?
settings.answer: Pure resin softens in warm hands and hardens in the fridge, dissolves fully in warm water leaving no grit, and smells smoky and earthy. Every batch of ours is also lab tested — see the Lab Reports page.

settings.question: How should I store ghee and shilajit?
settings.answer: Keep both in a cool, dry place with the lid closed and always use a dry spoon.
